result.title: StateAlign: Internalizing State-Aware Decision-Making for Reliable Multi-Turn Tool Agents via Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Reinforcement learning has improved the tool-use capabilities of large language models. However, better task performance can coincide with increased tool hallucination. Reliable tool use requires decisions to follow the current task state: available information, tool capabilities, and task progress. Our analysis shows that agents sometimes execute when they should ask for information, retrieve it, or decline an infeasible request, even when reasoning identifies missing information. We introduce StateAlign, combining task-state construction with state-contrastive reinforcement learning. The data cover five task conditions and pair states with different action requirements. Outcome rewards guide task completion; token-level contrasts compare the same generated reasoning and actions under paired states to train outputs that fit the current state. Experiments across five base models from three families show improvements on BFCL v4 multi-turn, ToolSandbox, and When2Call. Ablations show that state construction improves performance and reliability under different reward designs. The complete method further reduces tool hallucination across three Qwen3 sizes. On Qwen3-8B, StateAlign improves BFCL v4 multi-turn accuracy from 45.5% to 55.2% and reduces no-tool hallucination on SimpleToolHalluBench from 62.2% under outcome-only training to 56.1%. Behavioral analyses show more consistent decisions, more complete multi-call execution, and stronger recovery after tool errors.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多轮工具智能体的状态感知决策：先构造任务状态数据，再用状态对比强化学习把不同行动要求的状态配对，配合结果奖励与 token 级对比，让模型按当前可用信息、工具能力和任务进度决定询问、检索、拒绝或执行，并在 BFCL v4 多轮、ToolSandbox、When2Call 上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 「状态—行动需求」配对加对比监督的做法，可能可供核查迁移到 VLM 中「何时补充视觉证据、何时停止」这类状态条件化策略训练；但论文为纯文本工具场景，未涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，迁移仅为线索。
